state_definition: Retain the original validation-selected reward-tree family with up to eight states on residual_memory, IV, and VIX; 50/100/200% actions on the bottom-10% signal pool.
selection: Highest 2018-2021 funded annualized excess Sharpe across reward-tree candidates; ties prefer 60 months then lexical name
refit: Monthly, using only sample trades completed strictly before month start
objective: Annualized Sharpe of aggregated action-specific daily profit above cash in completed shadow trades
sample_selection: First trading signal date of each month, bottom residual-memory quintile; up to twelve evenly spaced ranks. Never use future label availability to select samples.
scope: Offline full-information contextual sizing bandit; no inventory inputs and no sequential inventory value function
test_status: Previously examined historical dates; validation-based choice is new, but the test is not untouched
validation_extension: Keep the reward-tree family retained in the original 20% experiment; compare 18/60-month training windows for the requested bottom-10% signal. Earlier 20% larger-ladder comparisons are incomplete and retained separately.
